description: After a purchase, report whether it actually fit. Free, safe to call, and only the first report per check counts. Reports are weighted by level: self_reported (website), agent_reported (anonymous API/MCP), partner_reported (API key holders) and order_confirmed (order evidence we've confirmed). Only the last two can raise future confidence.

check_id.description: The check_id returned by check_compatibility, find_parts or check_fit.

evidence.description: Optional order details we can confirm later (raises the report to 'order_confirmed' once reviewed). Order references only; payment and personal details aren't accepted.

name: report_outcome
title: Report what happened
